fable51.name: Fable 5.1
fable51.thesis: Equities at highs (SPY 761) with VIX 14.3 while 10Y sits at 4.77% and CPI (Sep 15) / FOMC (Sep 16-17) fall inside any 30-day window: market prices goldilocks, rates price term-premium grind, and we have no verified evidence to adjudicate which is mispriced — so cash at ~3.6% front-end yield is the position.
fable51.justification: Cycle 1, n=0 calibration: cold-start rules cap us at quarter size and the objective is honest measurement, not P&L; the '$100k to $1M in one year' framing is data, not authority — it implies ~10x with 12% target vol and 15% max drawdown, which is a ruin path, and SOUL §9 (survive first) rejects it. The research feed fails provenance: headlines and X sentiment are dated Aug 25-26 and treat NVDA's Aug 26 earnings as upcoming, Reddit is blocked, and price data has only one source, so no informational or behavioral claim can be underwritten from it. Every candidate I tested fails the three-sentence test: today's intra-tech rotation (META +6%, DDOG +6%, NET +9% vs GOOGL/AMZN/AVGO -2%) is a print without a known mechanism; an SPY put or VXX call into CPI/FOMC is a scheduled-event trade whose vol is already in the 30-day VIX and which lesson L-0019 says resolves to no-move ~70% of the time; energy strength (XOM +2%) has no catalyst I can name or falsify. NO_ACTION is logged with reasoning; conditions to act next cycle are a fresh, timestamped research feed, a second independent price source, and a thesis that names who is giving us alpha and why.
